crossRefs.note: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious…
Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
translations.bsb: For He says to Moses: “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
translations.kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
translations.asv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.
